text:
noah: quick flag  post-deploy smoke for /routing-heartbeat on canary spiking exactly at 03:00 UTC. p95 jumps and a cluster of probe failures that line up with our nightly-maint-cron. holding ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: rollout v7.4.0 -> v7.4.1 at 1829999900, canary 5%. smoke probes started 1829999950. failing probes 28/210 in the last 10m.

monitor-bot: timeline shows probe failures occurring at 03:00:12, 03:00:45, 03:01:12 repeatedly. host-level cron job "nightly-maint-cron" runs heavy disk checks and restarts a sidecar. correlated CPU sys spikes on canary nodes.

alan: we actually bumped the cron to run every hour in the release (intended for non-prod only) but canary inherited it via config templating. that's likely the trigger.

noah: argh, config templating slipped. prefer to disable cron on canary via config override and re-run synth rather than rollback. less blast radius.

ops-bot: canary override command:
```
POST /internal/configs/overrides
{ "scope": "canary", "schedules.nightly-maint-cron.enabled": false }
```
Applying now. propagation ~20-45s.

ci-bot: release pipeline log: commit a9b7c3f (release/v7.4.1)  no infra changes except the templated cron toggle. config-only override safe.

deploy-bot: synth runners restarting 1830000010 -> collecting 60 targeted samples/min for /routing-heartbeat.

monitor-bot: 2m after override: probe failure rate dropped from 13% -> 0.8%, p95 back to baseline. sidecar restarts stopped.

alan: will fix templating to ensure non-prod-only schedules don't leak to canary. opening ENG-OPS-712 for template guard.

product: tagging for visibility. if we had continued ramp customers might've seen intermittent latencies; will draft a short note referencing "scheduled-maint overlap in canary" if needed.

noah: leaving hold until 5m observation window completes. if stable, we'll resume ramp to 25% and keep the override until next patch cleans the template.

monitor-bot: 30m mark: sustained stable metrics, failures 0.1%, p95 within baseline. hold released at 1830000299. saved traces to /var/releases/1829999999/traces.

noah: closing thread. root cause: canary inherited maintenance cron via templating; mitigation: canary override + template guard in next patch.
